name: Takaoka Kiyoko
source:
She recently lost her husband in an accident. She suffered burns on her left hand that left an unsightly scar, so she always wears gloves. Having lost her husband in the prime of her womanhood, she constantly feels physical loneliness.

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041023222235/http://www.bishoge.jp/scoop/products/museum/yuwaku.htm]ScooP archived page[/url]]
